ideas.pitch: An AI-powered multi-agent route optimization platform for local municipal fleet management, combining traffic density analytics with carbon emission forecasting.
ideas.title: BurnabyEcoRoute
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the multi-agent architectural patterns proven in GreenNovation AI Platform while targeting localized civic utility.

ideas.pitch: An automated geospatial risk scoring platform utilizing satellite monitoring and graph intelligence to assess industrial land compliance in British Columbia.
ideas.title: PacificRiskScan
ideas.why_it_could_win: Employs heavy domain-specific spatial analytics similar to GeoNex-ATLAS, which appeals strongly to technical engineering judges.

ideas.pitch: A localized nutrition and surplus food distribution assistant that matches regional grocery inventories with community health needs.
ideas.title: BCFoodShare AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Follows the tight scope and practical consumer utility demonstrated by E-Foodiee-AI-Nutrition-Assistant, making it highly demonstrable in a live demo.

ideas.pitch: An AI-driven sentiment and trust acquisition engine tailored for local student health clinics and wellness centers in Burnaby.

ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly adapts the specialized patient acquisition trust loop proven in Global-Smile to an educational or local healthcare setting.

ideas.pitch: An AML risk detection and transaction monitoring dashboard that combines graph intelligence with explainable machine learning models.
